rule.title: Hardcoded immutable address is the sole authorization guard for privileged operations

intent.attack_thesis: A privileged function is guarded solely by a comparison of msg.sender to a hardcoded PUSH20 address. If that private key is compromised, the attacker has unconditional permanent control with no revocation mechanism.

reporting.title_template: Hardcoded EOA address is the sole guard for privileged functions
reporting.summary: Matches privileged functions guarded solely by comparison to a PUSH20 immutable address with no multisig, timelock, or role system.
reporting.user_summary: The contract uses a single hardcoded address as the only safeguard for privileged operations. If that private key is compromised or lost, the attacker gains permanent unconditional administrative control with no revocation mechanism.
reporting.technical_summary: The detector identifies guard catalog entries of type eq_caller_immutable where a PUSH20 literal is compared to msg.sender as the sole gate for functions with sensitive effects. No OZ Ownable2Step, AccessControl, Timelock, or multisig pattern is present as a suppressor.
reporting.exploit_narrative: The hardcoded admin private key is leaked or phished. The attacker uses the key to call any privileged function — upgrade implementation, withdraw treasury, change admin — without any additional authorization required.
exploit_preconditions: single EOA private key controls all privileged operations
no timelock, multisig, or governance delays the effect
remediation_hints: migrate admin control to a Gnosis Safe multisig or equivalent
add a timelock (OZ TimelockController) for all privileged operations
use OZ Ownable2Step to require active acceptance of admin role transfers
consider OZ AccessControl for role-based privilege separation

preconditions: hardcoded admin private key is known to attacker

steps.action: sign transaction from compromised hardcoded admin address and call privileged function
steps.expected_state: privileged effect (upgrade/withdraw/admin-change) executed with no other safeguard

witness_goal.success_condition: attacker gains full admin control after single key compromise
